responsibility: Declares the SFIO interface that pairs DynamicStrings with the FIO file subsystem, exporting file existence/opening routines that take string objects and read/write helpers that consume or produce DynamicStrings values. It is the public string-wrapper API above FIO’s raw array and pointer-based interfaces.
same_name_distinction: This header differs from GSFIO.cc by serving only as the interface layer for the DynamicStrings-to-FIO adapter, declaring the file-opening and string read/write routines without containing the conversion calls to GFIO or the line-reading/writing code present in the .cc implementation.
